 What kind of squad has Vučinić prepared to conquer Limassol - injuries and red cards determine the team
 Drešaj makes his debut, Rubežić replaces the insufficiently recovered Đurić, the captain plays at home - Montenegro plays its last match of the Nations League against Cyprus at 15 pm
 5764 views 4 comment(s) 
 Photo: FSCG 
 Disclaimer: The translations are mostly done through AI translator and might not be 100% accurate. 
 K 
 KB 
 15.11.2026. 09:00h 
 Many players during the hellish pace in September and October used Mirko Vučinić . Back then he had to do something like that because of fatigue, and now somehow injuries and a red card determine his squad for the last match of the Nations League in Division C.
 Montenegrin football players will close the C Nations League against Cyprus at 15 p.m. in Limassol and fight for a practically secure place in the Euro 2028 play-offs.
 The Montenegrin coach was left without three defenders in a short period of time. After Adam Marušić , they got hurt and Milan Roganović i Marko Vesovic , and after them and Andrija Bulatović - a midfielder who was forced to cover that position against Latvia. That's why the match in Limassol will be a chance for Jonathan Dreshai , captain Dečić who subsequently received a call-up.
 There will be neither Stefan Savić because of the red card against Latvia, and since he is not fully ready either Andrej Đurić , it is expected that with Igor Vujacic stopwatch tandem to make Slobodan Rubežić .
 In midfield, Bulatović will be replaced by Stefan Lončar whose sentence has expired, while the attack, with Nikola Krstović i Milutin Osmajić , to lead Stevan jovetić . The captain had problems before the meeting, but he is ready and will play in "his" Limassol, at the stadium where he plays with AEL. If he is not fit for the entire match, there is a good replacement in the form of Set Hakšabanovića .
 Possible lineup: Popović - Drešaj, Rubežić, Vujačić, Gasevic - Lončar, Janković, Adžić - Jovetić (Hakšabanović), Osmajić, Krstović.
